hypothesis: WP1104 treats HostCapabilityReport.report_digest() as sufficient evidence lineage even though HostCapabilityReport is publicly directly constructible and has no producer seal tying it to assess_host_adapter().
counterhypothesis: plan_generic_agent_route independently revalidates the report strongly enough that a directly constructed report with no assessed required lifecycle/capability evidence cannot produce an ADAPTED or NATIVE route candidate.
discriminator: Directly construct a HostCapabilityReport with classification=ADAPTED, empty required role/capability sets and no missing/unverified/conflict markers; bind only environment/state-lineage digests; feed it to plan_generic_agent_route. Counterhypothesis is falsified if a clean ADAPTED route is emitted.
expected_if_vulnerable: test PASS: forged direct-constructor report is accepted as ADAPTED with no fail-closed limitation
expected_if_hardened: test FAIL/raise: router rejects unsealed/unassessed report or independently reconstructs required assessment semantics
